```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
played <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(games_played > 0, season <= last_season) |>
  collect()
coverage <- stat_coverage(played)
division_colors <- c(
  "FBS" = "#374151",
  "FCS" = "#6b7280",
  "Division II and below" = "#9ca3af"
)
cov_at <- function(s, d, col) {
  coverage[[col]][coverage$season == s & coverage$division == d]
}
fcs_pre <- coverage |> filter(division == "FCS", season <= 2020L)
fcs_2020 <- filter(coverage, season == 2020L, division == "FCS")
fbs_depth_2015 <- cov_at(2015L, "FBS", "depth")
fbs_depth_2016 <- cov_at(2016L, "FBS", "depth")
fbs_roster_2015 <- cov_at(2015L, "FBS", "roster_size")
fbs_roster_2016 <- cov_at(2016L, "FBS", "roster_size")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(coverage, aes(season, share, color = division)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        season, ", ", division, ": ", with_stats, " of ", played,
        " teams (", scales::percent(share, accuracy = 1), ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(season, division)
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.02)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, last_season, 3)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = division_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of teams with a player stat line",
    subtitle = "Share of teams with at least one player stat line, by division",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Teams with a stat line",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "stat-line-coverage", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
coverage |>
  mutate(cell = paste0(with_stats, " of ", played)) |>
  select(season, division, cell) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = division, values_from = cell) |>
  left_join(
    coverage |>
      filter(division == "FBS") |>
      select(season, depth, roster_size),
    by = "season"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Season = season,
    FBS = FBS,
    FCS = FCS,
    `Division II and below` = `Division II and below`,
    depth = depth,
    roster_size = roster_size
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Season", "FBS teams with stat lines", "FCS teams with stat lines",
      "Division II and below teams with stat lines",
      "FBS median players with a stat line", "FBS median roster size"
    ),
    caption = sprintf(
      "Teams with at least one player stat line, of the teams that played at least one recorded game, by division and season, with the median FBS team's players with a stat line and roster size. From 2016 the stat records list about twice as many players per FBS team (a median of %d in 2015, %d in 2016) while roster sizes held level (%d and %d), so the change is in how many players the stat records include.",
      fbs_depth_2015,
      fbs_depth_2016,
      fbs_roster_2015,
      fbs_roster_2016
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tiles
fcs_tiles <- played |>
  filter(classification == "fcs") |>
  group_by(team) |>
  mutate(stat_seasons = sum(has_stat_lines)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(status = if_else(has_stat_lines, "Has stat lines", "No stat lines"))
p_tiles <- ggplot(
  fcs_tiles,
  aes(season, reorder(team, stat_seasons), fill = status)
) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        team, ", ", season, " (", coalesce(conference, "no conference"), ")\n",
        n_stat_players, " players with a stat line; ", n_roster, " on the roster"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Has stat lines" = "#6b7280", "No stat lines" = "#e5e7eb"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, last_season, 3)) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Every FCS team-season, with or without stat lines",
    subtitle = "Teams with the most stat-line seasons at the top",
    caption = "Gaps are seasons a school played outside FCS or played no recorded game."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 9)
card_interactive(p_tiles)
```
